Task: Compute EVI from Sentinel-2 imagery
Calculate the Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) from Sentinel-2A/B Surface Reflectance data over a specific region for four overlapping weekly periods in April 2020. It applies cloud and cirrus masking using the QA60 band, filters images by cloud cover (<10%), computes EVI using blue (B2), red (B4), and near-infrared (B8) bands scaled by 10,000, then generates a median EVI composite for each period. Outputs include printed image collections, map visualizations of mean EVI with a color palette, and exports of GeoTIFF files to Google Drive with COG format, each labeled by date range.

Task: Classify land cover types
Classify land cover in Guimaras using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellite imagery from 2017 to 2018. It first separates water (sea and inland) using radar backscatter thresholds and NDWI/MNDWI indices, then distinguishes vegetation, agriculture, forest, bare soil, built-up areas, and roads through a multi-step threshold-based classification using EVI, MSAVI, GNDVI, LAI, and a custom newBUI index derived from optical bands. The output includes masked raster layers for Water_sea, Land, Forest, Agri, Bare1, BuiltUp, and other intermediate products, with final manual editing recommended for accuracy refinement in specific features like rivers and urban areas.
